ticks.note: Tick 1 starts the chart in its initial state, `Locked`. Nothing has happened yet, so `unlocked` has its initial value, false.
Someone pushes the bar. `Locked` only reacts to `coin`, so nothing happens: the turnstile stays locked.
A coin drops. The transition from `Locked` to `Unlocked` fires and sets `unlocked` to true, in this same tick.
`coin` is still true, because an input keeps its value until it is changed. `Unlocked` does not look at `coin`, so a second coin changes nothing.
A push. The transition from `Unlocked` back to `Locked` fires and sets `unlocked` to false.
All quiet. The turnstile waits in `Locked` for the next coin.
